The Railway Recruitment Board has released the RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Score card 2026 on 26th August at the official website https://rrb.digialm.com/. All the candidates who have appeared for the RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Exam (CEN 07/2025) from 7th May to 20th June, can check the result pdf and scorecard. In order to download the RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard, candidate need to login using the Registration Number and Date of Birth/Password. RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Score card 2026 Out

As per RRB NTPC UG Results, a total of 45,898 candidates are qualified for the CBT 2 Stage. Is RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 Out? Yes, the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard Link has been activated on 26th August by the Railway Recruitment Board at https://rrb.digialm.com/. The scorecard pdf includes Candidate’s Name, Roll Number, Marks Obtained, Normalised Marks, RRB Zone, Selection Status & more. The scorecard will help candidates to understand their performance and check their eligibility for the next stage of the selection process i.e. CBT 2. The RRB NTPC CBT 2 Exam will going to be held on 17th September 2026.

How to Download RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026?

The following steps need to be followed by candidates to download the RRB NTPC Undergraduate Score Card after activation of the link.

Step 1: Go to the official website of Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) or regionals RRB sites.

Step 2: Click on the link RRB NTPC UG Scorecard under CEN 07/2025.

Step 3: Enter Registration Number and Date of Birth/Password.

Step 4: Login using your credentials.

Step 5: The RRB NTPC UG Scorecard will be displayed on your screen.

Step 6: Verify your score card and check all the details provided in it.

Step 7: Download the RRB NTPC UG scorecard.

RRB NTPC CBT 2 Syllabus 2026 PDF: Click to Check

Details Mentioned on RRB NTPC UG Result 2026 PDF

Candidates are advised to cross verify all the detail mentioned in their scorecard after downloading it. The following details will be mentioned on the RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Registration Number/Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Exam Name
  • Recruitment Notification Number (CEN 07/2025)
  • Category of Candidate
  • Raw Marks Obtained
  • Normalized Marks
  • Total Questions Attempted
  • Correct and Incorrect Answers
  • Qualifying Status for CBT 2
  • RRB Zone/Region
  • Candidate’s Question Paper and Correct Answers Link

Marking Scheme for RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Result

The marks that are shown on the scorecard are prepared after applying the normalisation process as the CBT 1 examination is conducted in different shifts. The final score is computed after considering:

Response Type Marks Awarded/Deducted
Correct Answer +1 mark
Incorrect Answer -1/3 mark
Unattempted Question 0 mark
Total Questions 100
Total Marks 100

What’s Next After RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard?

Candidates are advised to re-check their marks with the official category-wise cut off released by the Railway Recruitment Board once they download the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard. Candidates whose roll number is mentioned in the CBT 1 Result PDF are eligible to appear for the CBT 2 Examination which is to be conducted on 17th September 2026.

  • CBT 2 Exam
  • Skill Test/Computer Based Aptitude Test
  • Documents verification
  • Medical Examination

RRB NTPC UG CBT 2 Exam Date 2026

The RRB NTPC CBT 2 Exam Date for Under Graduate has been announced for 17th September 2026. Those who have cleared the CBT 1 examination will be eligible to appear for the 2nd stage Computer Based Test. The CBT 2 exam will be conducted online mode for 90 minutes consisting of 120 questions carrying 120 marks, General Awareness, Mathematics and General Intelligence & Reasoning. The RRB has also stated that the information for the CBT 2 city intimation will be provided approximately 10 days before the exam and the e-call letter will be available 4 days before the examination.

RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 FAQs

Ques: When will the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026 be released?

Ans: The RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 has been released on 26th August by the Railway Recruitment Board.

Ques: How can I download RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026?

Ans: Candidates can download scorecard through official RRB websites by logging in with Registration Number and DOB/Password.

Ques: Will the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard be released for all the candidates?

Ans: Scorecards is available for each candidate who appeared in the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Exam irrespective of their qualifying status.

Ques: What are the details mentioned on the RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard?

Ans: The scorecard includes all the personal information of the candidate, marks obtained, normalized marks, section-wise score, total marks and exam shift.

Ques: Is the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard different from the merit list?

Ans: The scorecard is different as it shows the individual marks, raw score & normalization details while the merit list is a public PDF for only the roll numbers of qualified students.
